nodes.norm_label: important: `today` is always passed in. callers resolve it with

nodes.label: NOTE: the PWA wrapper (@ducanh2912/next-pwa) gets added here in the final
nodes.norm_label: note: the pwa wrapper (@ducanh2912/next-pwa) gets added here in the final

nodes.label: Only leaf core/recommended topics count
nodes.rationale: alternative is pick-one (you learn React, not also Vue and Angular), so counting alternatives would cap the bar below 100% forever; optional is excluded for the same reason. A zero denominator yields null, rendered "—", which is a different statement from 0%.

nodes.label: Pure DB-free progress modules re-run client-side
nodes.rationale: All three progress modules take dates as YYYY-MM-DD strings and are re-run client-side for optimistic updates, so a mid-flight tap can never display a number the server would disagree with.
nodes.norm_label: pure db-free progress modules re-run client-side

nodes.label: roadmap-queries is the single DB path for a roadmap %
nodes.rationale: The Roadmaps page and any goal tracking that roadmap both read through src/lib/roadmap-queries.ts, so the two screens cannot disagree.
nodes.norm_label: roadmap-queries is the single db path for a roadmap %

nodes.label: APP_TIMEZONE (server-side definition of "today")
nodes.rationale: An IANA zone decides what "today" means for every habit, health and DSA log. Resolved server-side and passed down — never read from the browser clock, or an 11pm check-off lands on the wrong day.

nodes.label: Idempotent roadmap seed preserves progress
nodes.rationale: The seed upserts on (roadmap, parent, title) and deliberately does not touch status, so re-running it after editing a JSON file refreshes structure without wiping progress. In-app roadmap/topic creation writes to the same tables.

nodes.label: Habits has no bottom-nav tab
nodes.rationale: The bar deliberately stays at five (Today · Roadmaps · DSA · Goals · Health). /habits is the management screen; HabitCheckList is a self-contained component the Today dashboard will embed next pass.

nodes.label: Phase 1 scope and deferred phases
nodes.rationale: Built: Roadmaps, Goals, Habits, DSA, login, app shell. Still to come in Phase 1: Today dashboard, Health, PWA manifest/service worker. Later phases the schema already leaves room for: task list, money/spending, projects, learning calendar, analytics, Open Food Facts food database.

nodes.label: Tracker (self-hosted life-management PWA)
nodes.rationale: Single-user, self-hosted PWA keyed off "today": habits, DSA practice, learning roadmaps, goals, manual health log. Runs entirely on the user's own machine against their own Postgres — no accounts, no cloud, no third-party sync.

nodes.label: Unchecked today does not break a streak
nodes.rationale: The day isn't over, so counting starts from yesterday and only a past missed day ends the run. Weekly habits get no multi-week streak in Phase 1 — they report "3 / 5 this week" over a Monday-start week.
nodes.norm_label: unchecked today does not break a streak

nodes.label: db service (postgres:17-alpine)
nodes.rationale: Postgres 17 with a pg_isready healthcheck (5s interval, 10 retries); publishes ${DB_PORT:-5433}:5432 and persists to the pgdata volume.

nodes.label: pgdata volume
nodes.rationale: Named volume holding /var/lib/postgresql/data, so `docker compose down` keeps the data and only `down -v` wipes it.

nodes.label: web service (Next.js app container)
nodes.rationale: Built from the local Dockerfile, publishes 3000:3000, and receives DATABASE_URL, APP_PASSWORD, SESSION_SECRET, APP_TIMEZONE and COOKIE_SECURE from the environment.

nodes.label: DATABASE_URL uses the compose service name
nodes.rationale: Inside the compose network the database host is the service name `db` on port 5432 — distinct from the host-side localhost:5433 that .env uses for scripts run outside the container.
nodes.norm_label: database_url uses the compose service name

nodes.label: web waits on db service_healthy
nodes.rationale: depends_on with condition: service_healthy means Postgres comes up and passes pg_isready before web starts, so the app never boots against a database that is not accepting connections yet.

nodes.label: COOKIE_SECURE defaults to false
nodes.rationale: The app is opened over plain http:// on a LAN from a phone, and a Secure cookie would never be sent. Set true only once the app sits behind HTTPS.

nodes.label: Postgres published on 5433, not 5432
nodes.rationale: The machine already runs a native PostgreSQL service on 5432; colliding there makes host-side tools connect to the wrong server and fail with a confusing auth error. DATABASE_URL points at localhost:5433; DB_PORT overrides it.

nodes.label: E2E suite runs against the live containers
nodes.rationale: Playwright runs against the already-running containers, not a separate dev server. The suite creates and deletes its own data and restores any seeded topic it changes, so it is safe to re-run against the real database.
nodes.norm_label: e2e suite runs against the live containers

nodes.label: Goal progress precedence: roadmap > milestones > manual
nodes.rationale: A roadmap-linked goal uses its roadmap's %; otherwise milestones win whenever any exist; otherwise the manual slider. Reaching 100% never auto-completes a goal — status is always an explicit choice.
nodes.norm_label: goal progress precedence: roadmap > milestones > manual

nodes.label: Deleting a roadmap does not delete goals
nodes.rationale: goals.roadmap_id is ON DELETE SET NULL; such a goal falls back to manual progress and says so.
nodes.norm_label: deleting a roadmap does not delete goals

nodes.label: APP_PASSWORD (single-password auth)
nodes.rationale: There is no users table. One password lives in APP_PASSWORD; the login page checks it and sets a signed httpOnly session cookie.

nodes.label: SESSION_SECRET (HS256 session signing)
nodes.rationale: 32 random bytes hex; signs the session cookie via jose HS256 with a 30-day expiry.

nodes.label: APP_PASSWORD and SESSION_SECRET are required at startup
nodes.rationale: Both use the ${VAR:?message} form, so compose refuses to start the stack with a clear error rather than booting an app with an empty password or an unsigned session.
nodes.norm_label: app_password and session_secret are required at startup

nodes.label: Constant-time password comparison
nodes.rationale: node:crypto.timingSafeEqual over SHA-256 digests of both sides, so buffer lengths always match and the comparison cannot leak length or prefix timing.

nodes.label: Middleware session gate (except /login and PWA files)
nodes.rationale: src/middleware.ts gates every route except /login and the PWA files — the service worker and manifest must stay public or installing the app breaks.
nodes.norm_label: middleware session gate (except /login and pwa files)

nodes.label: Next 15 over Next 16 (webpack keeps the PWA)
nodes.rationale: @ducanh2912/next-pwa is a webpack plugin. Next 16 builds with Turbopack by default, which would skip the plugin silently and ship no service worker. Next 15 keeps webpack as the default build path.
nodes.norm_label: next 15 over next 16 (webpack keeps the pwa)

nodes.label: Explicit SQL migrations, never auto-pushed
nodes.rationale: Migrations are checked-in files. db:generate only diffs schema.ts against the migration journal and never touches a live database, so it is safe to run with nothing else up.
